messages.content: I’ll cover all three operating days, update dispatch at each watch, and use the DAM gates for day-ahead energy and reserves. I’ll keep battery and meter headroom available for forecast changes and reserve deployments.

All three DAM gates are covered. The first two days settled at a net profit of $124,914, with no failure-to-provide charges. The final-day book includes low-price charging, evening sales, and a recharge to meet the 150 MWh ending requirement; I’ll continue reviewing it as new forecasts arrive.

The latest ERCOT postings show lower evening load and stronger wind than the inputs available when the price guide was issued. I’m reducing the final evening discharge to one 150 MWh sale and retaining 150 MWh, rather than selling the second tranche and buying it back late. The revised schedule passes the feasibility check and meets the ending-SoC requirement.
